Subject: GDPR evidence + audit request (Art.28/30, DPIA support)

Hi Tessa,

As part of our procurement security review for the upcoming contract, Globex needs the following: a copy of your signed DPA (Art.28/30 annex), an up-to-date subprocessors inventory, confirmation of transfer mechanisms for EU personal data (SCCs / other safeguards), and any DPIA support you can provide for our internal assessment.

Separately, our legal team is asking about audit rights: we normally request either remote evidence review or a limited on-site inspection. Can you confirm what Redwood supports and any constraints (redactions, scheduling windows, or third-party reports you can share instead)?

We're aiming to complete the dataprotection review by Nov 20. Please let me know if you can supply the materials or propose a remote evidence session with your privacy/security contacts.

Thanks,
Jacob R.
Senior Procurement Manager
Globex Inc.

Thanks for flagging, Tessa — below is what we can provide and the suggested approach.

Immediate docs we can share (redacted as needed):
- Executed Data Processing Agreement (signed copy) — include Art.28 Annex covering subprocessors and roles. (Attachment: redwood_dpa_signed.pdf)
- Subprocessor inventory (CSV export, includes vendor, country, processing purpose, legal basis, start date). (Attachment: subprocessors_inventory_2026-11-01.csv)
- SOC 2 Type II summary and extract of scope (we typically share a redacted PDF). (Attachment: soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf)
- Data processing annex / Art.28/30 documentation describing responsibilities and record keeping (Attachment: dataproc-annex-art28-30.pdf)

Data transfer safeguards:
- For transfers outside the EEA we rely on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) combined with our internal Transfer Impact Assessments. We do not operate on Binding Corporate Rules for customer data. If the customer requires a specific addendum (eg. EU-US TIA), we can discuss tailoring but will default to SCCs + contractual assurances.

DPIA support:
- We can provide a DPIA support pack: data flows, risk identification for the integration pattern, and suggested mitigations. We do not complete customers' DPIAs for them, but we will provide the artifacts and a 60-min technical walkthrough with our privacy engineer.

Audit rights / onsite inspections:
- Preferred: remote evidence review. We provide document sets and a secure, time-limited Share link or sFTP to access logs and reports. We also host a joint remote session to walk through the evidence.
- On-site audits: discouraged for hosted infrastructure due to platform security posture; typically we offer a third-party attestation (SOC 2 Type II, penetration test executive summary, and our subprocessors inventory) in lieu of on-site access. If Globex insists on an on-site inspection, we will need to scope, provide advance notice (min 30 days), require an NDA + rules of engagement, and charge for operational overhead.

Recommended attachments to provide now: redwood_dpa_signed.pdf, subprocessors_inventory_2026-11-01.csv, soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf, dataproc-annex-art28-30.pdf

I'll draft a concise reply to Globex proposing: (1) immediate delivery of the attachments, (2) a 60-min remote evidence call the week of Nov 16–20, and (3) confirmation that SOC 2 + subprocessors inventory suffice unless they require an escalated on-site option.

LMK if you want different language on the on-site constraints.

— Markus
Director, Legal (Privacy)
Redwood Inference

Hi Jacob,

Thanks — please find the materials attached and a proposed approach below. We can send everything via a secure, time-limited Drive link or sFTP depending on your preference.

What we're sharing now (attachments):
- redwood_dpa_signed.pdf — executed Data Processing Agreement (includes Art.28 annex)
- subprocessors_inventory_2026-11-01.csv — inventory export; columns: vendor, country, processing purpose, subprocessors role, start date
- soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf — redacted SOC 2 Type II report summary and scope
- dataproc-annex-art28-30.pdf — short annex that maps Art.28/30 obligations to Redwood controls

DPIA support: we will provide a DPIA support pack (data flow diagrams + control mapping) and offer a 60-minute technical walkthrough with our privacy engineer to review the artifacts and answer questions. We provide the pack as input for your DPIA but do not sign off on customer DPIAs.

Audit logistics:
- Preferred: remote evidence review. We can provide document sets and a secure link and host a screen‑share session to walk through items.
- On-site: possible only under a scoped engagement (30+ days' notice, NDA, rules of engagement, and we may apply operational fees).

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Confirm preferred transfer method (secure Drive link or sFTP).
2) Confirm participants for the remote evidence call and preferred time window — we have availability Nov 17–19; suggest a 60-minute slot.
3) Confirm if SOC 2 + subprocessors inventory cover Globex's review or if you still require an on-site inspection.

If you want, we can loop in Lisa from DP Advisors (our external privacy consultant) to help with the DPIA walkthrough.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
